thread.title: Stock Market Tumbles On Caterpillar Earnings Miss, Nvidia Warning| Investor's Business Daily

author: ED CARSON
title: Stock Market Tumbles On Caterpillar Earnings Miss, Nvidia Warning| Investor's Business Daily
text:
The stock market opened sharply lower Monday morning as Dow Jones component Caterpillar ( CAT ) fell well short on fourth-quarter earnings views while chipmaker Nvidia ( NVDA ) slashed fourth-quarter guidance. Caterpillar stock and Nvidia stock plunged, with the latter slamming chip stocks down after last week's big semiconductor rally. The Dow Jones, S&P 500 index and Nasdaq composite tumbled at Monday's stock market open in a huge week for earnings and other market-moving news.
X Alexion Pharmaceuticals ( ALXN ) reported a positive late-stage trial.
A market retreat could help top stocks such as Salesforce.com ( CRM ), Microsoft ( MSFT ) and Boeing ( BA ) polish off handles, offering a lower entry.
Stock Market Soon after Monday's stock market open, the Dow Jones lost 1.5%, the S&P 500 index 1.25% and the Nasdaq composite 1.6%.
Last week, the major stock market averages tested their 50-day moving averages, but after a Friday rally, the Dow Jones and Nasdaq composite rose 0.1% for the week while the S&P 500 index lost 0.1%.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Stock Market: A Busy News Week This week's big news includes the first Fed meeting of 2019, high-level China trade talks in Washington and the January jobs report. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump said he's ready for another government shutdown if there's no border wall funding by Feb. 15.
But first and foremost this week is earnings, with Apple ( AAPL ), Microsoft, Boeing, Visa ( V ), Exxon Mobil ( XOM ) among the 13 Dow stocks reporting this week and 114 S&P 500 companies. So are several other top stocks, many of which are near buy points.
Caterpillar Earnings Despite the slew of quarterly financials this week, Caterpillar earnings are among the few notable reports today. Caterpillar earnings rose 18% to $2.55 a share in the fourth quarter, falling short of analyst estimates by 43 cents. Revenue rose 11% to $14.3 billion, roughly in line. Caterpillar earnings guidance for 2019 wasn't good either.
Big Cat is an global economic bellwether, so its weak results and guidance underscore the global slowdown, especially in China.
Caterpillar stock tumbled nearly 8% early in Monday's stock market trading , hitting Dow futures and S&P 500 futures. Shares bottomed on Oct. 24 but really began rallying after Christmas. Caterpillar stock had been moving toward its 200-day moving average as it tries to end a yearlong downtrend.
Nvidia Stock Dives Nvidia now sees fourth-quarter revenue of $2.2 billion vs. its prior target for $2.7 billion. It also cut its gross margins guidance. The graphics chipmaker cited weakness in China and data centers. Nvidia stock plunged 15% in morning trade. Chip stocks such as Intel ( INTC ) and AMD ( AMD ) also retreated, with AMD stock down 8%.
But Xilinx ( XLNX ) rebounded to turn up slightly. Xilinx led a huge semiconductor rally Thursday on earnings.
Intel stock plunged Friday on weak sales and guidance, but other chip stocks held up well. But Nvidia's warning shows that Intel isn't an isolated case.
Alexion Drug Study Alexion Pharmaceuticals reported that Ultomiris met the primary goal of complete thrombotic microangiopathy response — hematologic normalization and improved kidney function — in complement inhibitor-naïve patients with atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome.
Alexion fell 3.2% intraday. Shares have rebounded sharply since Dec. 24, reclaiming their 200-day line on Friday. But Alexion stock is still a long way from a 140.87 buy point.
Microsoft Stock, Salesforce Stock, Boeing Stock Dow Jones components Microsoft stock and Boeing stock, along with Salesforce stock, all formed handles on their current consolidations, giving them lower buy points. That is, on a weekly chart, but last week had just four trading sessions due to the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday. On a daily chart, the three stocks' handles are only four days, one short of the minimum required.
If Microsoft, Salesforce.com and Boeing stock can hold in their short-term range for one more day, they'll have proper handles without question. Salesforce stock, Microsoft stock, Boeing stock lost about 2% in morning trade. But for Monday, treat them as aggressive entries.
This is where a stock market pullback could be helpful. It's no coincidence that Salesforce stock has a four-day handle, matching the market's pause last week.
Boeing earnings are due Wednesday morning. Microsoft earnings are set for Wednesday night.
